changelog:
Initial release of Discharge Summary Writer.

- Generates standardized hospital discharge summaries from structured patient data.
- Supports multiple output formats: human-readable, structured, and JSON.
- Requires manual clinical data input; does not connect to live EMR systems.
- Provides safety guidance and technical documentation to ensure compliant use.
- Includes customizable templates and language settings (zh/en).
- Marked as high-risk: output requires physician review before use.
